coder_notes: Eligible histologies include IDH-wildtype GBM, IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 2-4 and H3-mutant diffuse midline/hemispheric gliomas; IDH and H3 status define allowed histologies rather than a single entry requirement, so no IDH/H3K27M eligibility row was recorded. G6PD is a germline safety marker and is not recorded. Tumour PK coded yes based on peri-tumoral dialysate (microdialysis) and planned CSF sampling. RRM2 (triapine's target subunit, record calls triapine an RNR inhibitor) is a baseline correlative marker, not a pharmacodynamic measurement, so target_engagement coded no.
